title: Natural Micro-Lens Magnification of Oak Tracheid Pits
content:
Abstract
Unexpectedly, images were obtained that show magnification of sub-optical microscope-sized oak tracheid pits using ordinary brightfield microscopy of macerated wood slurry. We propose that pits in upper tracheids act as micro-lenses to magnify neighboring pits in a second tracheid, underneath the first. Tracheid pits are slightly irregular, and because of that the images of pits from the magnified tracheids are blurry. However, it is rewarding to see something so counterintuitive; submicroscopic features using an ordinary microscope.
